talent_role.desc: Physical and magical attack +300 per level
Critical Hit Resist rate+1% per level
Physical and magical pierce+0.5% per level

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: What a nice nap that was. I'm Luffy and I'm hungry! Now where am I?
Eh, there's someone in the barrel? I'm -0-. This is Alvida's pirate ship and I'm here to defeat her.

army_word_cfg.name: Coby
army_word_cfg.content: Ah! Don't beat me... My name is Coby, a caretaker serving Alvida, but I want to escape! I just don't have the guts to do it…

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Well, how about you help me find some food then run away with me when I'm full?

army_word_cfg.name: Coby
army_word_cfg.content: No way...My legs will tremble whenever I think I'll be captured by Alvida...

army_word_cfg.name: Pirate Swordsman
army_word_cfg.content: Hey! Who's hiding there?!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: You're pretty stupid and useless, and you seem kinda wimpy, Coby. I don't like you.

army_word_cfg.name: Coby
army_word_cfg.content: (So direct...) Er... So, Luffy, why are you sailing?

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Me? Hehe... I want to become the Pirate King!

army_word_cfg.name: Coby
army_word_cfg.content: Are you telling me you're looking for the greatest treasure in the world, the [One Piece]? Aren't you scared?

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: This is my dream, so I wouldn't even mind dying for it!
(He's thinking the same thing as me...)

army_word_cfg.name: Coby
army_word_cfg.content: If I'm willing to die...Will I accomplish it...? Will I be able... to become a Marine? I...I want to arrest Alvida!!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Hurry up, Coby! Let's find the villagers.

army_word_cfg.name: Coby
army_word_cfg.content: Lu...Luffy, are you serious? What if Alvida finds out...

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: You're such a coward, Coby. Don't worry, we're here. Alvida won't dare bully you again.

army_word_cfg.name: Peppoko
army_word_cfg.content: Hey! Who's there!

army_word_cfg.name: Coby
army_word_cfg.content: Shoot, we're done for!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: What are you afraid of, Coby? -0- , let's go!
No problem!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Are the Alvida pirates all as weak as this? That's boring!

army_word_cfg.name: Coby
army_word_cfg.content: Eh...Luffy, you're really strong.
Luffy, I found the captured villagers. Let's escort them back to the village first.

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Hey Coby, where's Alvida? I'm starving...I need meat!

army_word_cfg.name: Coby
army_word_cfg.content: The storage room is right over there. Maybe we can find some food there.
Someone's here!

army_word_cfg.name: Heppoko
army_word_cfg.content: Who are you, boy? How dare you intrude on the Alvida Pirates' ship!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Don't stop me from eating meat!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Great, done! Now which one shall I choose...I'll start with this!
Luffy, be quick. We still need to deal with Alvida.

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Mmmm...Okay....

army_word_cfg.name: Rene
army_word_cfg.content: Wait, -0- . Let me join you!
Great! We can save a lot of time with Miss Rene here.

army_word_cfg.name: Rene
army_word_cfg.content: Fufufu, I'm a rather skilled swordsman. My skill can greatly decrease an enemy's attack, so leave the defense to me!
What a relief. Thanks for your help, Rene!

army_word_cfg.name: Alvida
army_word_cfg.content: Who did you say you are going to arrest, Coby? Did you think you can escape from me?

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Coby, tell her who you're going to arrest!

army_word_cfg.name: Coby
army_word_cfg.content: I...I'll become a Marine and arrest you, you fat and ugly hag!!!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Haha!

army_word_cfg.name: Alvida
army_word_cfg.content: (Angry) Do you know what you're saying?! You're dead, you brat!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Coby, get behind me. Let me deal with this "fat and ugly hag"!

army_word_cfg.name: Heppoko
army_word_cfg.content: His arm extended...Captain Alvida was beaten...

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Prepare a boat for us. Coby wants to join the Marines, so stay out of his way!

army_word_cfg.name: Heppoko
army_word_cfg.content: Y...Yes

army_word_cfg.name: Coby
army_word_cfg.content: You actually ate the Devil Fruit. That's surprising...
Devil Fruit...

army_word_cfg.name: Coby
army_word_cfg.content: But, you have to get into the Grand Line if you're looking for the [One Piece]...

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Yes, that's why I need friends.
Er...Luffy, can we adventure together?

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Sure, you're pretty good! I'm looking for someone in Shells Town, come with me.
Someone... You don't mean the pirate hunter Zoro?

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Yup. If he's a good guy, I'd ask him to join me.
You ate the Devil Fruit. You guys seem quite strong.

army_word_cfg.name: Marine Enforcement Team Leader
army_word_cfg.content: Invaders!
( Luffy and -0- rescued Zoro successfully) I heard that you're quite strong. Where's your sword?

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Taken away by Lieutenant Morgan's bastard son Helmeppo.

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Then how about this? I'll get your sword back and then you join me! I'm the man who will become the Pirate King!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: A pirate? ...I'll never join you.

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Hey...Straw Hat, can you pick that rice roll up for me?

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: It's all muddy. You want to eat this?!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Shut up.

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Give Zoro's swords back!

army_word_cfg.name: Helmeppo
army_word_cfg.content: I won't make it easy for you!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Then I'll let you taste my fists!
Ignoring the treasure for some broken swords. What an idiot. Lucky me!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: (Luffy got Zoro's sword back) Which one is your sword? I couldn't figure it out, so I brought all three of them.

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: All three belong to me. I use three swords.

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Now will you accept my proposal? Although defying the Marines together with me will make you an outlaw. Or you want to die here?

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: What a troublesome man...
Anyway, let's go back first. Rika must be worried about us.

army_word_cfg.name: Commander Ripper
army_word_cfg.content: You're stronger than I thought… no matter, prepare to die!

army_word_cfg.name: Marine
army_word_cfg.content: (Panic with cold sweat) That guy is unbelievable... How did he manage to repel those bullets?!

army_word_cfg.name: Commander Ripper
army_word_cfg.content: He doesn't seem normal. He must have eaten some kind of Devil Fruit.

army_word_cfg.name: Marine
army_word_cfg.content: Devil fruit? He ate the ocean's secret treasure?

army_word_cfg.name: Marine
army_word_cfg.content: Capture him!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: You...I'd say you are the offspring of the devil. Anyway, after this incident with the marines, I'll agree to...become a pirate!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: But...I have my own ambition!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Yes! You're now one of our companions!
(Sweat) Ambition? What kind of ambition?

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: I'm going to be the world's greatest swordsman! If you do something that ends up in the way of my goal, I'll have you cut your stomach open to say sorry!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: The world's greatest swordsman, good! Since you're the pirate king's crew member, you have to accomplish something like this!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Heh, well said. Good or bad no longer matters as long as my name is known worldwide!

army_word_cfg.name: Marine
army_word_cfg.content: Lieutenant...They're too strong. We can't defeat them!

army_word_cfg.name: Morgan
army_word_cfg.content: This is an order: Whoever just said that, shoot and kill yourself!

army_word_cfg.name: Morgan
army_word_cfg.content: What are you waiting for? Go kill them!

army_word_cfg.name: Marine
army_word_cfg.content: (Scared and stepping back) They're too strong. We can't even defeat Zoro alone! Not to mention a man who ate the devil fruit…

army_word_cfg.name: Morgan
army_word_cfg.content: Humph, useless trash. I'll kill you myself!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: You're someone who only knows how to boast about himself. I'll beat you down in one hit.

army_word_cfg.name: Coby
army_word_cfg.content: Morgan has been defeated. Great!

army_word_cfg.name: Coby
army_word_cfg.content: Luffy, Zoro, and -0-, thank you all...You give me courage! I'm going to Marine Headquarters with the ship!
Haha. Once you're a marine, please be lenient on us, Coby!

army_word_cfg.name: Coby
army_word_cfg.content: (Crying loudly) I'll miss you…

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Stop crying. That's why I don't like him. Let's go, -0-, Zoro.

army_word_cfg.name: Coby
army_word_cfg.content: (Excited) We'll meet again on the Grand Line someday!

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: Ah, boss, you're finally here to save me.
Huh? Who are you?

army_word_cfg.name: Pirate Swordsman
army_word_cfg.content: Hey, hand out the nautical chart!

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: I'm Nami, a thief who only steals treasure from pirates.
Pirate burglar? Why did you steal nautical map? Do you know how to navigate?

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: I'm a navigator. My skill is first class!
Then you can come join in as my navigator.

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: No problem, as long as you take me to find captain Buggy.
Sure, deal!

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: (Nami bound -0- and went to see Buggy) I came into an argument with my boss, so I'll give him to you. Please let me join your crew, Mister Buggy!

army_word_cfg.name: Buggy
army_word_cfg.content: Hahaha, sure, I'll let you join my crew…

army_word_cfg.name: Buggy
army_word_cfg.content: But first, use this Buggy Cannonball to get rid of your old boss and swear to me your loyalty!

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: Ah...Boss, drink, let's drink. Just ignore that guy.

army_word_cfg.name: Buggy
army_word_cfg.content: Nami, are you disobeying my order? Do you want to betray me?

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: Please let me explain!

army_word_cfg.name: Buggy
army_word_cfg.content: There's nothing to explain. Mohji, go kill Nami and this boy.

army_word_cfg.name: Mohji
army_word_cfg.content: Lying to the great captain Buggy. Go die!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: (Luffy and others arrived) -0-, how did you get captured?

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: And you are?
They are my friends. This is Nami, my new navigator!

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: Let me clarify first, I never said I was going to join you.

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: You're injured -0-. Let's get back to the town first.

army_word_cfg.name: Cabaji
army_word_cfg.content: So you are the pirate hunter Zoro. Let's see if you're as strong as they say!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: I'd suggest you not. Otherwise you'll die.
Zoro, let me help you.

army_word_cfg.name: Cabaji
army_word_cfg.content: Then I'll slay you two together!

army_word_cfg.name: Pirate Swordsman
army_word_cfg.content: Ahhh, Mohji and Cabaji are all beaten. Run, everybody!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Cabaji the Acrobat is too weak. Boring!

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: Hey, don't just try to act cool. Let's head back to town and rest before dealing with Buggy next.

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: That damned red nose!

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: (Frightened) You can't say that name. I know you're strong, but Buggy's not weak either!
Huh, why should we be afraid of that red nose?

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Mmmm, that red nose will be a good object for me to test my sword on.

army_word_cfg.name: Buggy the Clown
army_word_cfg.content: I heard you talking and I'm really angry! It's time to show you my real strength!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Humph...Red nose, watch out my Gum-Gum Pistol!!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: (Luffy's hat was damaged during the fight) I promised Shanks that I would return this hat to him…

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: The hat means so much to you? I can fix it for you, Luffy.

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Really? Thank you so much, Nami!

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: Here's your hat.

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Awesome!
Nami, would you like to be our navigator?

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: No no, this was just a one-time cooperation. I only like money and oranges!
That's fine. Let's go!

army_word_cfg.name: Usopp
army_word_cfg.content: I can't just let people get killed. I'm going to stop these pirates!

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: I didn't know you were this brave.
Well, let us lend you a hand.

army_word_cfg.name: Usopp
army_word_cfg.content: I don't need your pity!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: I won't fight out of pity!

army_word_cfg.name: Chief Swordsman
army_word_cfg.content: You want to stop us? Hahahahaha!

army_word_cfg.name: Jango
army_word_cfg.content: You think that is the end? (Jango hypnotizes his crew, increasing their strength.)

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Zzzzzzzzz
(Sweat) Shoot, Luffy's been hypnotized too.

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: That idiot. Never mind, he won't die!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Who are those men?
They are not as strong as people think.

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: Hey! Can't you stop irritating them!

army_word_cfg.name: Jango
army_word_cfg.content: Well, I still have a trump card. Get down here, Nyaban Brothers!

army_word_cfg.name: Buchi
army_word_cfg.content: Sham, these two guys are strong. You go first.

army_word_cfg.name: Sham
army_word_cfg.content: Buchi, I can't do it. You go first.

army_word_cfg.name: Usopp
army_word_cfg.content: Hehehe, le me send you home.
Be careful, Usopp. Don't be fooled by their appearance.

army_word_cfg.name: Buchi
army_word_cfg.content: Let me show you the real strength of the Nyaban Brothers!

army_word_cfg.name: Sham
army_word_cfg.content: Ouch...Buchi, I'm doomed. Captain Kuro will kill us.

army_word_cfg.name: Buchi
army_word_cfg.content: Sham, we can't beat them... Better run away!

army_word_cfg.name: Usopp
army_word_cfg.content: Stop running, you two! Taste my Marble Shot!
Captain Kuro went to the seashore as the agreed time has passed.

army_word_cfg.name: Kuro
army_word_cfg.content: Don't tell me you were stopped by these kids? Since when have the Black Cat Pirates been a bunch of weaklings?!

army_word_cfg.name: Pirate Swordsman
army_word_cfg.content: Ca...Captain!

army_word_cfg.name: Jango
army_word_cfg.content: Captain, they're not normal kids.

army_word_cfg.name: Kuro
army_word_cfg.content: Five minutes! If you can't defeat them in 5 minutes, I'll kill you with my own hands!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: I'll finish all of you in less than 5 minutes!
Be careful of his hypnosis. Those pirates no longer feel pain.

army_word_cfg.name: Jango
army_word_cfg.content: Seems like I have to do it myself!

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: You guys take care and don't get killed! I'll be leaving now…

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Nami, where are you going!

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: (Fierce) My treasure is still on the ship! Hurry and deal with them, I'll go protect my treasure!
(Sweat) That's so like you…

army_word_cfg.name: Kuro
army_word_cfg.content: You think you can stop me? My plan will never fail. I don't need trash like this to help me.
Kuro starts to attack his own crew members.

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: (Angry) This is how you treat your own crew?!
Stop! They're dying!
Kaya and Merry went to the beach and saw everything in disbelief.

army_word_cfg.name: Kaya
army_word_cfg.content: Kurahadol...What's all this about? You used to be so gentle...Tell me this isn't true!

army_word_cfg.name: Merry
army_word_cfg.content: Miss...

army_word_cfg.name: Kuro
army_word_cfg.content: Hehe, what an ignorant lady. Let me wake you up from your sweet dream!

army_word_cfg.name: Usopp
army_word_cfg.content: Don't touch Kaya! You'll need to beat me first!

army_word_cfg.name: Kuro
army_word_cfg.content: Ugh...I just wanted to stop being a pirate and live a peaceful life...

army_word_cfg.name: Kaya
army_word_cfg.content: Thank you, Usopp. Thank you, everyone.

army_word_cfg.name: Usopp
army_word_cfg.content: That's nothing, haha. I am the great Captain Usopp!

army_word_cfg.name: Merry
army_word_cfg.content: This is a small gift from me. Thank you!

army_word_cfg.name: Kaya
army_word_cfg.content: Food and some necessities are already on the ship.

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: (Admiring) Wow, this ship is so cool, especially the bow...
What's the name of the ship?

army_word_cfg.name: Kaya
army_word_cfg.content: This ship is especially designed by Merry. The name is Going Merry!

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: (Admiring) Cool!
Usopp, off to the sea with us! You'll meet your father some day!

army_word_cfg.name: Usopp
army_word_cfg.content: (Crying) Okay...I'm the captain, right?

army_word_cfg.name: People
army_word_cfg.content: To the new ship and new member! Cheers!

army_word_cfg.name: Fullbody
army_word_cfg.content: Waiter, why is there an insect in my soup!

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: Oh, let me just take out that out for you.

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: By the way (smoking) I'm Sanji, the assistant head chef of this restaurant. Now here's your soup.

army_word_cfg.name: Fullbody
army_word_cfg.content: Do you know who I am? How can I have something like this! (Throws the soup to the ground)

army_word_cfg.name: Fullbody
army_word_cfg.content: Arrest this chef!

army_word_cfg.name: Marine officer
army_word_cfg.content: Yes, sir!

army_word_cfg.name: Fullbody
army_word_cfg.content: You brat, how dare you attack the Marines. Arrest them all!
Seems like we can't just stand by.

army_word_cfg.name: Fullbody
army_word_cfg.content: What are you doing! So this restaurant has been working with pirates! I'll finish you all with my own hands!

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: Whoever messes with a chef in the middle of the sea, that person has committed suicide. Remember this!
The fierce battle has damaged many tables and chairs in the Baratie.

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: Alas, we must compensate a lot of money! My treasure...

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: Nami is so cute!

army_word_cfg.name: Patty
army_word_cfg.content: (Humming) Today I have to treat them nicely. Customers are gods!

army_word_cfg.name: Patty
army_word_cfg.content: What is this...!!! A...a customer!? It's you again, Sanji!? What are you doing to our customer!

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: Tut (smoking) So what? He just insulted the chef by playing with food.

army_word_cfg.name: Fullbody
army_word_cfg.content: What kind of restaurant treats customers like this...I will tell the Marines to destroy this place!

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: You want to destroy this place? Well then, I can't let you live now.

army_word_cfg.name: Krieg
army_word_cfg.content: Sorry… Could you give me some food and water? Money is not a problem.

army_word_cfg.name: Gin
army_word_cfg.content: Mr. Sanji...I know I shouldn't come back. But please, save our captain. Or he'll die!

army_word_cfg.name: Patty
army_word_cfg.content: This is impossible. He's Krieg. If he regains his strength, he'll destroy us! We must contact the Marines now!

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: Get out of my way, Patty (Kicks Patty aside and brings a plate of fried rice)! Give this to him, Gin!
After finishing the rice, Krieg beats Sanji and tries to occupy Baratie.

army_word_cfg.name: Gin
army_word_cfg.content: You...What about the promise! Captain Krieg! That man just saved our lives!

army_word_cfg.name: Krieg
army_word_cfg.content: This feeling is really great! It's a very nice restaurant. So I'll take it!

army_word_cfg.name: Patty
army_word_cfg.content: What! How can you do this! Look what you've done, Sanji!

army_word_cfg.name: Krieg
army_word_cfg.content: Prepare 100 servings of food! I have many starving crewmen!

army_word_cfg.name: Zeff
army_word_cfg.content: Here you go...Take this to your crew...

army_word_cfg.name: Patty
army_word_cfg.content: Zeff! What do you mean! If we give the pirates food, they'll take our restaurant!

army_word_cfg.name: Zeff
army_word_cfg.content: That will depend on their spirit...Isn't that right? Fugitives from the Grand Line!

army_word_cfg.name: Krieg
army_word_cfg.content: Zeff...You are Zeff the Red Leg!

army_word_cfg.name: Krieg
army_word_cfg.content: I heard that you got into an accident. Though you're still alive, you lost your leg!

army_word_cfg.name: Krieg
army_word_cfg.content: Excellent, I want to have your journal of the Grand Line!

army_word_cfg.name: Zeff
army_word_cfg.content: My journal… It's too much for someone like you.

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: Zeff, step back, leave it to me!

army_word_cfg.name: Krieg
army_word_cfg.content: Hey, Gin, you deal with that chef!

army_word_cfg.name: Gin
army_word_cfg.content: Captain...I can't do this...

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: Gin?

army_word_cfg.name: Gin
army_word_cfg.content: Captain Krieg, this is too much!

army_word_cfg.name: Krieg
army_word_cfg.content: This is an order from your captain!

army_word_cfg.name: Gin
army_word_cfg.content: Sorry, Sanji.
Krieg takes the food back to his ship.

army_word_cfg.name: Gin
army_word_cfg.content: Sanji… I'm so sorry! I never thought that it would turn out like this, I...

army_word_cfg.name: Zeff
army_word_cfg.content: Hey! You don't need to apologize. Every chef here does what they want for their own sake.

army_word_cfg.name: Patty
army_word_cfg.content: Boss, you're still protecting Sanji… but those pirates want to destroy our restaurant!

army_word_cfg.name: Zeff
army_word_cfg.content: Shut up, you idiot! (Angry) Have you even been through a situation where you had no food to eat and no water to drink? Have you ever known the suffering of being without food or drink in the middle of the sea?

army_word_cfg.name: Patty
army_word_cfg.content: Eh… what do you mean, Boss?

army_word_cfg.name: Zeff
army_word_cfg.content: I don't have time to talk about this. If you have time, why don't you just get out of here through the back door?

army_word_cfg.name: Patty
army_word_cfg.content: I will stay here and fight! This place is where I work!

army_word_cfg.name: Gin
army_word_cfg.content: What...What are you thinking! Krieg will come with his ship soon. You'd better get out of here!

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: (Smoking) I must tell you that it is my duty as a chef to give food to starving people.

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: But if the man dares to take this restaurant (angry), even you, I will kill that person without mercy!! Understand?

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: See? He's a good man, right?

army_word_cfg.name: Usopp
army_word_cfg.content: I don't care bout him! We'd better get out of here first!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: By the way, Gin, you told us you went to the Grand Line once. Tell us something!

army_word_cfg.name: Gin
army_word_cfg.content: (In Pain) I still can't believe what happened to us… A man suddenly appeared in the sea...and destroyed a fleet of 50 ships by himself!

army_word_cfg.name: Crowds
army_word_cfg.content: What… No way! Only one person did that?

army_word_cfg.name: Gin
army_word_cfg.content: I don't know whether the other ships made it or not. When we saw the man's eyes, we felt that we were dead already. I don't want to think about it...

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: What!?

army_word_cfg.name: Zeff
army_word_cfg.content: No doubt, that had to be the work of the Hawk-Eye.

army_word_cfg.name: Usopp
army_word_cfg.content: Hawk...Hawk-Eye? Who is that?

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: (Absent minded) Dunno...

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: He's the man I'm looking for. Well, my destination seems clear. I'm going to the Grand Line!
Krieg came back to Baratie with his men who had eaten all the food.

army_word_cfg.name: Krieg
army_word_cfg.content: Pearl, finish these annoying ones first.

army_word_cfg.name: Usopp
army_word_cfg.content: Don't come closer! I am Captain Usopp with a crew of 80 million!

army_word_cfg.name: Pearl
army_word_cfg.content: Oh, really? Then I'll start with you!

army_word_cfg.name: Pearl
army_word_cfg.content: What is this? Blood...Blood! Ahhhhhhhh!!!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: What's going on? Is he mad?
Whatever. Let's finish him, Luffy!

army_word_cfg.name: Krieg
army_word_cfg.content: Useless trash. Shall I finish you myself?

army_word_cfg.name: Krieg's follower
army_word_cfg.content: Captain, they are strong...They don't seem like ordinary pirates...

army_word_cfg.name: Krieg
army_word_cfg.content: What did you say?

army_word_cfg.name: Krieg's follower
army_word_cfg.content: No...Nothing

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: Bring it on! I'll protect this restaurant!
Well, we're already involved in this mess. Let's fight together!

army_word_cfg.name: Krieg
army_word_cfg.content: You won't beat me!
A mysterious man showed up just as the battle on Baratie ended.

army_word_cfg.name: Gin
army_word_cfg.content: It's him! The one who destroyed our fleet!

army_word_cfg.name: Patty
army_word_cfg.content: What? He looks like a normal guy… and it doesn't seem like he's carrying any special weapons...

army_word_cfg.name: Zeff
army_word_cfg.content: The weapon is on his back! And he is the most renowned swordsman in the world… People call him "Hawk-Eyes" Mihawk!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: No wonder you are the  strongest...You cut 50 ships with one swords? I set sail to meet you!

army_word_cfg.name: Hawk Eye
army_word_cfg.content: Oh? What do you aim for?

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: To be the strongest! You're free, right? So let's have a duel!

army_word_cfg.name: Hawk Eye
army_word_cfg.content: Ignorant weakling...I don't need to draw out my sword to see the clear difference between you and I.

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: This is my ambition...and a promise to a friend!

army_word_cfg.name: Hawk Eye
army_word_cfg.content: Hehe...ambition? I can just use this small blade. Now then, show me your ambition!

army_word_cfg.name: Hawk Eye
army_word_cfg.content: Why do you refuse to step back?

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: (Laugh) I'd much rather die than step back!

army_word_cfg.name: Hawk Eye
army_word_cfg.content: Kid, tell me your name!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Roronoa Zoro.

army_word_cfg.name: Hawk Eye
army_word_cfg.content: Good. You are definitely not an ordinary swordsman. And to pay my respect to you as a fellow swordsman, I shall end your life with my black sword, the world's strongest sword!
Realizing his defeat, Zoro spread his arms and faces Hawk-Eye with his chest.

army_word_cfg.name: Hawk Eye
army_word_cfg.content: Kid, what do you think you're doing?

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: A wound on one's back is the shame of a swordsman!!
Zoro!!!

army_word_cfg.name: Hawk Eye
army_word_cfg.content: A friend of the swordsman? Relax, that man... is still alive.

army_word_cfg.name: Usopp
army_word_cfg.content: Zoro! Hurry! Somebody save him!

army_word_cfg.name: Hawk Eye
army_word_cfg.content: Be strong, Roronoa Zoro! I shall stand at the top of the world and wait for you!  Try to surpass me!

army_word_cfg.name: Hawk Eye
army_word_cfg.content: (Turns to face Luffy) Boy, what do you aim for?

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Pirate King!

army_word_cfg.name: Hawk Eye
army_word_cfg.content: A tough path indeed. Even tougher than surpassing me!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: I'm going to be the Pirate King even if it costs me my life!
Zoro wakes up and raises his sword.

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Can you hear me?
Zoro...

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Sorry for worrying you...-0- . I...If I don't become the world's greatest swordsman, it will embarrass you.

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Zoro! Please don't talk any more. You're still bleeding!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: I'm never...going to lose again!! (Crying) Until the day I become the world's greatest swordsman, I'll never lose again!! Any problems, Pirate King?!

army_word_cfg.name: Hawk Eye
army_word_cfg.content: Hehe, Zoro. You make a good team. I'd like to see you again sometime in the Grand Line.
At this point, a noise comes out from the restaurant. Patty rushes out.

army_word_cfg.name: Patty
army_word_cfg.content: Bad...bad news! Nami has gone to Cocoyasi Village with the Going Merry!
Usopp, Arlong Park is around there, right? Nami must be heading there.

army_word_cfg.name: Usopp
army_word_cfg.content: Yep. Those chefs saw Nami taking Arlong's wanted poster and left.
Ah...Nami's really good at picking places...

army_word_cfg.name: Fishman Pirate
army_word_cfg.content: Who are you! How dare you come to Arlong Park!

army_word_cfg.name: Usopp
army_word_cfg.content: Shoot, there are guards!
You! Answer me, is Nami in Arlong Park?

army_word_cfg.name: Fishman Pirate
army_word_cfg.content: Ye...Yes. Nami is inside…
Let's hurry and find Nami.

army_word_cfg.name: Kuroobi
army_word_cfg.content: Wait, where are you going? I can't let you in unless you tell me what are you up to!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Where is Nami?

army_word_cfg.name: Kuroobi
army_word_cfg.content: So you're here for that human. I won't let you in!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Nami, hurry, come with me!

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: You...why are you here?
We're here for you. You're our navigator!

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: I won't leave with you. I have my reasons to stay here! You should leave now. Arlong will come back soon.
The reason you staying here is you want to protect the village. We'll help you defeat Arlong and his men.

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: Who needs your help? Hurry up and leave! (Nami runs away)

army_word_cfg.name: Hatchan
army_word_cfg.content: You are not Arlong's guests. Who are you?
We're pirates!

army_word_cfg.name: Hatchan
army_word_cfg.content: And you, green hair, you must be pirate hunter Roronoa Zoro. I'll let you taste my six swords!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Hmph, bring it on!

army_word_cfg.name: Hatchan
army_word_cfg.content: Come on, guys!

army_word_cfg.name: Hatchan
army_word_cfg.content: Roronoa Zoro, you can't kill me. Because I have 6 arms!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: You octopus!
Zoro! Your injury hasn't healed yet! Don't push yourself too hard!

army_word_cfg.name: Hatchan
army_word_cfg.content: You want to pretend you're sick? I won't be fooled. Let me show you my true strength!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: So you're Arlong?

army_word_cfg.name: Arlong
army_word_cfg.content: Boy, you still don't know who am I?
Luffy sends Arlong flying.

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Don't you dare make my navigator cry!

army_word_cfg.name: Fishman Pirate
army_word_cfg.content: You brat, how could you beat captain Arlong!

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: Ahah, you shouldn't hog all the glory for yourself.

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: They won't lose without you.

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: What did you say, seaweed head!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: What? You spiral eyebrow!

army_word_cfg.name: Fishman Pirate
army_word_cfg.content: How dare you ignore us!

army_word_cfg.name: Usopp
army_word_cfg.content: I...I don't particularly mind if you want so, Luffy...

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: You sure are brave.

army_word_cfg.name: Chew
army_word_cfg.content: Eh? That long-nose is still alive? You should be dead!

army_word_cfg.name: Usopp
army_word_cfg.content: Want to beat me? Stop dreaming!

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: Damn...Damn...Damn!

army_word_cfg.name: Arlong
army_word_cfg.content: Your money is stolen? That's quite unfortunate of you. But a promise is a promise. You have to pay me 100 million beli again.

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: You vile monster...

army_word_cfg.name: Arlong
army_word_cfg.content: Shahahaha. It's only 100 million beli. All you need to do is to save up that much again!
Damn. Let go of Nami!

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: (Cry)-0-…Luffy...every one...sorry. Help me!
Of course we will help you!
How dare you make our navigator cry!

army_word_cfg.name: Arlong
army_word_cfg.content: You think you can beat me? Have a try!
Luffy, Zoro, every one!

army_word_cfg.name: Nojiko
army_word_cfg.content: Hey, Nami, why not come back and live with us?

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: Hehheh. -0-, take off now!

army_word_cfg.name: Usopp
army_word_cfg.content: Ah, what's the hurry?
Going Merry left Cocoyasi Village. Nami reveals that she stole all of the money from the village.

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: Goodbye, everyone! I'll be off now!

army_word_cfg.name: Genzo
army_word_cfg.content: You thieving cat!

army_word_cfg.name: Nojiko
army_word_cfg.content: I should have known better from my own sister.

army_word_cfg.name: Tashigi
army_word_cfg.content: Pirate hunter Roronoa Zoro. To think you're now a pirate. I'm going to arrest you!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: And you are?

army_word_cfg.name: Tashigi
army_word_cfg.content: I am Sergeant Tashigi. You don't deserve the named sword, Sungdai Kitetsu!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Oh? Then have a try.

army_word_cfg.name: Tashigi
army_word_cfg.content: Attention, arrest all the pirates!

army_word_cfg.name: Marine
army_word_cfg.content: Yes, Sergeant Tashigi!
That was close. Loguetown really has high security!

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: We should avoid problems.

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: These guys can't even stand a single blow!

army_word_cfg.name: Usopp
army_word_cfg.content: Be careful, we've been exposed. And that Marine girl is chasing us.

army_word_cfg.name: Tashigi
army_word_cfg.content: There you are!

army_word_cfg.name: Tashigi
army_word_cfg.content: Roronoa Zoro, I will defeat you with my own hands!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: You go first. Leave it to me!

army_word_cfg.name: Tashigi
army_word_cfg.content: Roronoa Zoro! Don't you dare run away!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Don't you understand? You can't defeat me!

army_word_cfg.name: Mohji
army_word_cfg.content: Aren't they with that rubber boy? He's going to be executed by Captain Buggy.

army_word_cfg.name: Mohji
army_word_cfg.content: Go Richie! Bite them!

army_word_cfg.name: Richie
army_word_cfg.content: Grrr!
They're indeed the Buggy Pirates.

army_word_cfg.name: Usopp
army_word_cfg.content: We must save Luffy!
Lucky, we can see Luffy already.

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: I'm so excited!

army_word_cfg.name: Alvida
army_word_cfg.content: Aren't you -0- and Luffy?
Who are you?

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: -0-, how do know such pretty lady!
I don't remember knowing someone this pretty.

army_word_cfg.name: Alvida
army_word_cfg.content: How could you forget? You were the first man to ever hit me. I am the beautiful lady Alvida!
Ah, how'd you change so much? Did you eat a devil fruit?

army_word_cfg.name: Alvida
army_word_cfg.content: Hehe… The devil fruit I ate is the Slip-Slip Fruit. Now, it's time for me to take revenge by cutting off your head!

army_word_cfg.name: Buggy the Clown
army_word_cfg.content: Gyahahahaha. You should be proud of dying in the same place as the Pirate King!

army_word_cfg.name: Buggy the Clown
army_word_cfg.content: Guilty! Pirate Monkey D. Luffy, for the crime of angering me…

army_word_cfg.name: Buggy the Clown
army_word_cfg.content: I sentence you to a flashy execution!!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Wow, this is the first time I've seen an execution.

army_word_cfg.name: Buggy the Clown
army_word_cfg.content: Hey, you're the one who's being executed here!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: What! Are you kidding me!

army_word_cfg.name: Buggy the Clown
army_word_cfg.content: No! You're the one joking around!

army_word_cfg.name: Buggy the Clown
army_word_cfg.content: Anyway… Any last words? There's quite a crowd here.

army_word_cfg.name: Buggy the Clown
army_word_cfg.content: Well, whatever. Whether you have any last words or not, no one would care about.

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: I'm the man who'll become the Pirate King!!!

army_word_cfg.name: Smoker
army_word_cfg.content: Hey, what are you doing here in my territory? Capture them!

army_word_cfg.name: Marine
army_word_cfg.content: Yes, sir!
Let's head back to the Going Merry!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: There's going to be a big fight here!

army_word_cfg.name: Smoker
army_word_cfg.content: Trying to run away, Straw Hat Luffy? No pirate has ever gotten away from me in Loguetown.

army_word_cfg.name: Smoker
army_word_cfg.content: I won't let you escape from here!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: What?! Ahh!

army_word_cfg.name: Smoker
army_word_cfg.content: You finally ran out of luck.
I don't think so!

army_word_cfg.name: Smoker
army_word_cfg.content: What!?
Now, Luffy, hurry!
It begins raining heavily with strong winds.

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: Hurry up, let's leave under the cover of the rain!

army_word_cfg.name: Usopp
army_word_cfg.content: I'll go prepare the ship!

army_word_cfg.name: Smoker
army_word_cfg.content: I won't let you get away so easily! Catch them!
-0- and others successfully escaped. However, they've caught the eye of Smoker.
So everyone has decided to go to an island and find a doctor to cure Nami first.

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Wow! An island!!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: It's white. So it must be a snow island!

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: Hey, Luffy, I must tell you that we won't have time to play.

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: We have to find doctor to cure Nami and then set sail again.

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Snow is so beautiful.
He didn't hear a single word... Everyone get ready!

army_word_cfg.name: Dalton
army_word_cfg.content: Don't move, pirates!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Hey, there are people here.

army_word_cfg.name: Usopp
army_word_cfg.content: They don't look friendly.

army_word_cfg.name: Dalton
army_word_cfg.content: Get off of this island...now!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: We're looking for a doctor!

army_word_cfg.name: Vivi
army_word_cfg.content: We have a sick person on board!

army_word_cfg.name: Guard
army_word_cfg.content: That trick won't work, you evil pirates!

army_word_cfg.name: Guard
army_word_cfg.content: This is our country, and we won't let you in!

army_word_cfg.name: Guard
army_word_cfg.content: Get out, or we'll shoot you!

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: They act as if they've hated us for a long time.

army_word_cfg.name: Dalton
army_word_cfg.content: Cut the crap. I won't let you enter!

army_word_cfg.name: Usopp
army_word_cfg.content: What are you doing!

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: Are you trying to mess with us?

army_word_cfg.name: Vivi
army_word_cfg.content: Stop, Sanji! Aaah!
While Vivi was try to stop Sanji, she was hurt by a bullet.

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Vivi!! How dare you!!!

army_word_cfg.name: Guard
army_word_cfg.content: Get ready!!

army_word_cfg.name: Vivi
army_word_cfg.content: Wait, Luffy, don't fight them! I'm ok. The bullet missed me.

army_word_cfg.name: Vivi
army_word_cfg.content: If you fight them, we may all get hurt. What will happen to Nami then?

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: I'm sorry...It's my fault!! Please call a doctor. Please help my friend.
Luffy and Vivi get down on their knees

army_word_cfg.name: Dalton
army_word_cfg.content: (Shocked)...

army_word_cfg.name: Dalton
army_word_cfg.content: I...will show you the way to our village. Follow me!

army_word_cfg.name: Kuromarimo
army_word_cfg.content: Dr. Kureha, how dare you stay in the castle while we're away!

army_word_cfg.name: Dr. Kureha
army_word_cfg.content: Heeheeheehee...I have no interest in this shabby castle. But he...

army_word_cfg.name: Dr. Kureha
army_word_cfg.content: He wants to have Hiluluk's cemetery here.

army_word_cfg.name: Kuromarimo
army_word_cfg.content: Lord Wapol, he's that monster!

army_word_cfg.name: Chopper
army_word_cfg.content: Doctor just wanted to help this country! That's why I can't allow you to get into the castle!

army_word_cfg.name: Chopper
army_word_cfg.content: I will never allow anyone to take doctor's faith down from here!!

army_word_cfg.name: Wapol
army_word_cfg.content: Maaahahahaha, if all of you wanted to die, why didn't you just ask? I'll kill you all!

army_word_cfg.name: Kuromarimo
army_word_cfg.content: How dare you to use this sacred castle as that charlatan's cemetery! Watch out, Electric Marimo!

army_word_cfg.name: Chopper
army_word_cfg.content: Get out of this country!!

army_word_cfg.name: Wapol
army_word_cfg.content: Get out of the way, Chess! (Wapol opens his mouth, trying to swallow Chopper)

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: Look out!

army_word_cfg.name: Dr. Kureha
army_word_cfg.content: Chopper!

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: Luffy, grab my leg now!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Your leg? Like this?

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: Ok, don't let go. [Air Force - Rubber Shot]!
Sanji kicks Luffy towards Wapol and saves Chopper from being swallowed.

army_word_cfg.name: Wapol
army_word_cfg.content: Ugh!!

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: Phew...not bad at all.

army_word_cfg.name: Wapol
army_word_cfg.content: I'll kill them all! I'll show them the power of the Munch-Munch Fruit!!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Luffy, what are you doing at the top of the castle?

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: I just kicked that king away.

army_word_cfg.name: Dalton
army_word_cfg.content: So...the thing that just flew away is Wapol!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: How about the other two?

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: That reindeer has beaten them down! Hey, listen up, I found a new crew member!

army_word_cfg.name: Dalton
army_word_cfg.content: Reindeer...beat them down? Anyway, thank you very much! I'm sure Drum Kingdom will become better from now on!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Reindeer! Let's set sail together!!

army_word_cfg.name: Chopper
army_word_cfg.content: I...thank you. But I can't go with you!

army_word_cfg.name: Chopper
army_word_cfg.content: Because...I am a reindeer! I have hooves and horns! I also have a blue nose!

army_word_cfg.name: Chopper
army_word_cfg.content: Though I want to be a pirate... But I can't be friends with humans! I'm a monster!

army_word_cfg.name: Chopper
army_word_cfg.content: So...I...only want to say thank you for asking me!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Just shut up and come with us!!!

army_word_cfg.name: MR.3
army_word_cfg.content: Welcome to my Candle Feast!

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: There's something turning around over our heads.

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Feels like the candle on a cake.

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: I can't move my legs...

army_word_cfg.name: Vivi
army_word_cfg.content: Something's falling from above… what is that?

army_word_cfg.name: MR.3
army_word_cfg.content: Hahaha! How's the taste of my Candle Feast?

army_word_cfg.name: MR.3
army_word_cfg.content: The candle mist that falls from above will soon turn you into candle toys!

army_word_cfg.name: MR.3
army_word_cfg.content: Die for the sake of my art, you should feel honored!

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: No way! Why should I die for your art?

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Usopp...don't you think these people are unforgivable?

army_word_cfg.name: Usopp
army_word_cfg.content: Sure. I'll finish them...

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Good! Let's go together and crush all of them!!

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: It seems like I have to defeat this okama if I want to get by...

army_word_cfg.name: MR.2
army_word_cfg.content: Show all your skills… because I've trained hard everyday!

army_word_cfg.name: MR.2
army_word_cfg.content: There's no one can crush my Okama Kenpo!

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: Damn that okama bastard... I even used the Mutton Shot...

army_word_cfg.name: MR.2
army_word_cfg.content: Stop joking around! I even used the Swan Wind Wing Open against that loser chef...

army_word_cfg.name: MR.2
army_word_cfg.content: I'm being serious from now on!

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: Just go ahead...

army_word_cfg.name: MR.2
army_word_cfg.content: I...I lost...

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: What? If you change into Nami now, I wouldn't be able to kill you.

army_word_cfg.name: MR.2
army_word_cfg.content: Ha...How funny...I can't even move now.

army_word_cfg.name: MR.2
army_word_cfg.content: You win! Kill me now! My life will be ended by the organization any way...

army_word_cfg.name: MR.2
army_word_cfg.content: What are you waiting for? Hurry and finish me off!!

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: That was a good fight. The rest doesn't really need to be said...

army_word_cfg.name: Vivi
army_word_cfg.content: Kohza!!

army_word_cfg.name: Kohza
army_word_cfg.content: Am I seeing things?!

army_word_cfg.name: Kohza
army_word_cfg.content: I came here...to persuade the Royal Army.

army_word_cfg.name: Kohza
army_word_cfg.content: Why would the king nearly get killed by the hero of the country? I...I won't believe this...

army_word_cfg.name: Vivi
army_word_cfg.content: Kohza, in fact...

army_word_cfg.name: Kohza
army_word_cfg.content: The person who took away the rain from this country---who the hell is he?

army_word_cfg.name: Vivi
army_word_cfg.content: It was all...

army_word_cfg.name: Crocodile
army_word_cfg.content: Me. Kohza! Everything you thought the king did was done by me!

army_word_cfg.name: Crocodile
army_word_cfg.content: It would be better if you hadn't known about this.

army_word_cfg.name: Crocodile
army_word_cfg.content: Cause you would have died much easier. Kuhahaha!

army_word_cfg.name: Kohza
army_word_cfg.content: Crocodile!!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Your body is hard to cut...It's not normal...

army_word_cfg.name: MR.1
army_word_cfg.content: Yes...I ate the Dice-Dice Fruit...and become a Blade Man!

army_word_cfg.name: MR.1
army_word_cfg.content: The man who defeated 100 men in the Whiskey Peak is you, right?

army_word_cfg.name: MR.1
army_word_cfg.content: The man who refused to join Baroque Works and killed Mr.7 is also you, right?

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Ha...That is a long time ago.

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: But that was all your fault. Why didn't you accept my condition?

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: I said to that agent "I'll join you if you made me the boss",

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: But that guy didn't agree and attacked me. So I had to kill him.

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Are you going to persuade me? Tell your boss to get lost.

army_word_cfg.name: MR.1
army_word_cfg.content: Don't look down upon others! You are just a pirate swordsman!

army_word_cfg.name: MR.1
army_word_cfg.content: In this battle, he grew so much...

army_word_cfg.name: MR.1
army_word_cfg.content: Next time...Are you going to cut through diamonds?

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: I don't know yet...

army_word_cfg.name: MR.1
army_word_cfg.content: Haha...I accept my failure...

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: I caught up! Crocodile!

army_word_cfg.name: Crocodile
army_word_cfg.content: Why are you still alive? Why do you come back every time I kill you!

army_word_cfg.name: Crocodile
army_word_cfg.content: Why? Straw hat?

army_word_cfg.name: Crocodile
army_word_cfg.content: How many times do I need to kill you?

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Because you still haven't returned something you took away.

army_word_cfg.name: Crocodile
army_word_cfg.content: The thing I took away? Is it money, fame, life, or rain? Do you want me to give back?

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: It's the country!

army_word_cfg.name: Crocodile
army_word_cfg.content: Country? Don't be ridiculous. I've just obtained this country, and soon I'll be the king to rule this land!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: From the time we came here, her country was already gone.

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: If this is truly her country… why does she never laugh?

army_word_cfg.name: Crocodile
army_word_cfg.content: You look like you really want to defeat me.

army_word_cfg.name: Crocodile
army_word_cfg.content: Then I have to regard you as a real enemy!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Really....

army_word_cfg.name: Crocodile
army_word_cfg.content: This is the last time. We'll battle it out!
After successfully defeating Crocodile, everyone decide to meet Vivi at the Eastern coast---

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Let's go, it's almost time...

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: She's definitely coming. I'll look for her!

army_word_cfg.name: Usopp
army_word_cfg.content: Hey, bad news! The marines caught up with us again!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: How many are there? Let's sail now.

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: Forget it, Luffy. She's not the same Vivi that was with us now.

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: (Not convinced) ...

army_word_cfg.name: Vivi
army_word_cfg.content: Everyone!!!!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: (Excited) Vivi!!

army_word_cfg.name: Vivi
army_word_cfg.content: I'm here to say goodbye...

army_word_cfg.name: Vivi
army_word_cfg.content: Sorry, but I can't go with you! Thank you all for what you have done for me!

army_word_cfg.name: Vivi
army_word_cfg.content: Even though I still want to go with you, but right now I can't.

army_word_cfg.name: Vivi
army_word_cfg.content: Because I really love my country!! So I can't come along!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: ...Really?!

army_word_cfg.name: Vivi
army_word_cfg.content: Even though I...I decided to stay here, but...

army_word_cfg.name: Vivi
army_word_cfg.content: But if there's one day we meet each other again, will you still take me as a friend?

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: You're always....

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: We shouldn't answer her. The marines already noticed Vivi...

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: Let's just part quietly...
Everyone raises their left arm to reveal the sign of their friendship!
Let's sail!!
After leaving Alabasta, the journey to Skypiea has started. However, no one knows where Skypiea is. Therefore, they decide to go to Mock Town and look for some information first.

army_word_cfg.name: Salvage King Masira
army_word_cfg.content: Listen to me, every sunken ship around here is mine!
We're not here to salvage. ..

army_word_cfg.name: Salvage King Masira
army_word_cfg.content: Then you're after the gold? I won't let!

army_word_cfg.name: Salvage King Masira
army_word_cfg.content: Don't mess with me in my territory!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: We don't have time to talk with you, you monkey!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Humph…

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: Get out of the way! (Kick Masira away)

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Another weirdo?

army_word_cfg.name: Sonar King Shoujou
army_word_cfg.content: How dare you hurt our father!!

army_word_cfg.name: Sonar King Shoujou
army_word_cfg.content: Jeez...and I thought it was somebody dangerous. It was making me a little bit edgy.

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: You have a very strange face. What species are you?

army_word_cfg.name: Sonar King Shoujou
army_word_cfg.content: I'm a human! You punk!

army_word_cfg.name: Sonar King Shoujou
army_word_cfg.content: You really don't know how strong I am?

army_word_cfg.name: Sonar King Shoujou
army_word_cfg.content: Ever since I was born, I have never had a hair cut. That's 25 years without a haircut! Did I surprise you?

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Don't talk nonsense with him. Let me finish him.

army_word_cfg.name: Cricket
army_word_cfg.content: You're all after the gold, right? Go die!

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: Whoa!

army_word_cfg.name: Chopper
army_word_cfg.content: Sanji! AHHHHHH!

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: Don't worry. He missed! Hey, wait a minute!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: You idiot, that's what you get for taking him on. Uh?
Cricket suddenly fell to the ground, twitching.

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: Hey!?

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Bellamy, where are you!

army_word_cfg.name: Bellamy
army_word_cfg.content: Calling for me like that… We were just talking about you. Do you have something to say to me?

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Yes. Return diamond-head mister's gold back to him!

army_word_cfg.name: Bellamy
army_word_cfg.content: Gold? You mean Cricket's treasure?

army_word_cfg.name: Bellamy
army_word_cfg.content: I shouldn't have to do that. It's my loot as a pirate.

army_word_cfg.name: Bellamy
army_word_cfg.content: You're a pirate too. You don't have the right to say stuff like that to me.

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Yes, I do! They're my friends. So I will take the gold back to them!

army_word_cfg.name: Bellamy
army_word_cfg.content: Hahahahah! Can you fight? Do you know how to punch? Hahahah!

army_word_cfg.name: Bellamy
army_word_cfg.content: If you stand here like an idiot just like in the morning, you won't be able to take anything from me, wimp!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: What happened in the morning is a different matter.

army_word_cfg.name: Bellamy
army_word_cfg.content: This time, I'll beat you up until you won't ever have the chance to bluff like that again!

army_word_cfg.name: Bellamy
army_word_cfg.content: Golden City, Sky Island… The age for daydreams is over!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: You asked if I know how to punch, right?

army_word_cfg.name: Bellamy
army_word_cfg.content: Farewell! Straw hat!
Boom! One hit KO against Bellamy!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Look, that man fell off his horse.

army_word_cfg.name: Doc Q
army_word_cfg.content: Excuse me, can you two help me up...?

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: You just don't want to pick yourself up, right?

army_word_cfg.name: Doc Q
army_word_cfg.content: Ah, sorry, I have been weak physically since childhood...

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Even the horse is weak...

army_word_cfg.name: Doc Q
army_word_cfg.content: A token of my gratitude… please have an apple...

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: No thanks… Just hurry up and leave...

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Ah! Apples! Thanks!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Hey! Hey! Luffy, Don't eat them!
A sound of explosion came from afar. Someone exploded after they ate an apple.

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: What are you trying to pull here?!

army_word_cfg.name: Doc Q
army_word_cfg.content: Hahah...Cough...Don't worry...He's fine. If he took the wrong one, he would have been dead on the first bite.

army_word_cfg.name: Doc Q
army_word_cfg.content: That kid is safe… Haha… Cough… You're really lucky!

army_word_cfg.name: Blackbeard
army_word_cfg.content: You are… a pirate?

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Yes!

army_word_cfg.name: Blackbeard
army_word_cfg.content: Bounty?

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: 30 million!

army_word_cfg.name: Blackbeard
army_word_cfg.content: 30 million? You...? You're lying!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: I'm not lying! It's true!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Knock it off!

army_word_cfg.name: Blackbeard
army_word_cfg.content: Hey… Don't fight in the bar!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Go ahead!

army_word_cfg.name: Ohm
army_word_cfg.content: You're the third one to get here today.

army_word_cfg.name: Chopper
army_word_cfg.content: I… I was too full of myself!——I should go back first! Now I'm dead!

army_word_cfg.name: Ohm
army_word_cfg.content: Don't be so afraid. That dog's name is Holy. He is my pet… He won't bite you.

army_word_cfg.name: Chopper
army_word_cfg.content: B… But this man is covered in blood!

army_word_cfg.name: Ohm
army_word_cfg.content: That man was chopped by me.

army_word_cfg.name: Chopper
army_word_cfg.content: That's even worse! Who are you!?

army_word_cfg.name: Ohm
army_word_cfg.content: My name is Ohm… You should be quiet… Right now, I'm...

army_word_cfg.name: Ohm
army_word_cfg.content: Busy feeling sorrowful for these mortals. Life is nothing but a dream..

army_word_cfg.name: Ohm
army_word_cfg.content: Why are they in such a hurry to die in a battle?

army_word_cfg.name: Chopper
army_word_cfg.content: Huh? What...?

army_word_cfg.name: Ohm
army_word_cfg.content: People live for prosperity, yet for prosperity they fight and die...

army_word_cfg.name: Ohm
army_word_cfg.content: Thus, wouldn't it be better if they hadn't done anything to begin with?

army_word_cfg.name: Ohm
army_word_cfg.content: Oh sorrow... But, there's still a way to salvation...

army_word_cfg.name: Ohm
army_word_cfg.content: All they need to do is to die!!

army_word_cfg.name: Chopper
army_word_cfg.content: This guy is a super psycho!

army_word_cfg.name: Ohm
army_word_cfg.content: Why are you here?

army_word_cfg.name: Chopper
army_word_cfg.content: I...I'm here to find gold...

army_word_cfg.name: Ohm
army_word_cfg.content: If you want that, you must fight. (Pulls out a sword) Allow me to save you.

army_word_cfg.name: Chopper
army_word_cfg.content: I don't want to be saved by you!

army_word_cfg.name: Shura
army_word_cfg.content: First you tell me not to attack your friends, then you tell me not to destroy this ship...

army_word_cfg.name: Shura
army_word_cfg.content: Then you say you don't want to die...

army_word_cfg.name: Shura
army_word_cfg.content: You selfish animal, you really piss me off.

army_word_cfg.name: Shura
army_word_cfg.content: Why are you so weak!

army_word_cfg.name: Chopper
army_word_cfg.content: Whoa! Stop… That lance burns stuff!

army_word_cfg.name: Shura
army_word_cfg.content: You want to live without any sacrifice?

army_word_cfg.name: Shura
army_word_cfg.content: If someone wants to survive… then someone else must die… This is reality...

army_word_cfg.name: Shura
army_word_cfg.content: You must give your life to god!

army_word_cfg.name: Chopper
army_word_cfg.content: No!
When Chopper is about to be hit by Shura, Knight of the Sky Gan Fall appears!

army_word_cfg.name: Gan Fall
army_word_cfg.content: Thanks for waiting!

army_word_cfg.name: Chopper
army_word_cfg.content: Knight of the Sky!!

army_word_cfg.name: Shura
army_word_cfg.content: Gan Fall! Huh… A rare guest!

army_word_cfg.name: Gan Fall
army_word_cfg.content: Let's fight harder, Pierre.

army_word_cfg.name: Shura
army_word_cfg.content: Old men like you are useless! Let's play with him, Fuza!

army_word_cfg.name: Satori
army_word_cfg.content: Huhuhuhu! Welcome to my Ordeal of Balls!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: This is your Ordeal of Balls? Are you a ball?

army_word_cfg.name: Satori
army_word_cfg.content: Hoh hoh hooooo

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: Stop dancing! Who are you?

army_word_cfg.name: Usopp
army_word_cfg.content: Looks like another idiot...

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: Hey, Octopus, are Nami and the others alright?

army_word_cfg.name: Satori
army_word_cfg.content: I don't care...They'll probably die anyway.

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: What did you say!!

army_word_cfg.name: Satori
army_word_cfg.content: You should worry about yourselves. If you can't beat me, you can't move forward.

army_word_cfg.name: Usopp
army_word_cfg.content: He's coming, Luffy! Go kick his ass!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Ok! I'll knock him down!

army_word_cfg.name: Gedatsu
army_word_cfg.content: Where did he disappear to? Does he has the ability to turn invisible...?

army_word_cfg.name: Chopper
army_word_cfg.content: Ah! He's making white eyes! So scary!

army_word_cfg.name: Priest Guardian
army_word_cfg.content: Gedatsu, if you do that eye thing, you can't see the enemy!

army_word_cfg.name: Gedatsu
army_word_cfg.content: Ah! I was careless!

army_word_cfg.name: Chopper
army_word_cfg.content: Is this guy an idiot? Enemy! Are you a… priest?

army_word_cfg.name: Gedatsu
army_word_cfg.content: (Bite lips) That's right! I am the Sky Boss Gedatsu!

army_word_cfg.name: Gedatsu
army_word_cfg.content: I am also one of the mighty Enel's priests!

army_word_cfg.name: Priest Guardian
army_word_cfg.content: Gedatsu! You have to say it loud!

army_word_cfg.name: Gedatsu
army_word_cfg.content: Hunh! Take a look at where you're standing! You're in my territory!

army_word_cfg.name: Gedatsu
army_word_cfg.content: Swamp clouds are planted everywhere. Once you're trapped by the swamp, you'll never get out!

army_word_cfg.name: Gedatsu
army_word_cfg.content: The survival rate is...

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Are you the bastard Enel?

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: Luffy!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: What did you do to my friends!

army_word_cfg.name: Enel
army_word_cfg.content: Show some respect… I am god!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: You don't look like god!

army_word_cfg.name: Enel
army_word_cfg.content: I hear the cheers of the party...

army_word_cfg.name: Enel
army_word_cfg.content: The citizens seem to know about the fate of Skypiea...Yahaha...

army_word_cfg.name: Enel
army_word_cfg.content: I wonder where are they running to?

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: I said, you don't look like god!

army_word_cfg.name: Enel
army_word_cfg.content: I will show you soon enough.

army_word_cfg.name: Enel
army_word_cfg.content: I see… So you are not a simple mortal… However...

army_word_cfg.name: Enel
army_word_cfg.content: Paramecia type makes no difference to me!

army_word_cfg.name: Enel
army_word_cfg.content: Because... I am god!!

army_word_cfg.name: Enel
army_word_cfg.content: God's judgment! 100 million volts!!
Luffy was not hurt at all after being hit by the thunder.

army_word_cfg.name: Enel
army_word_cfg.content: What?

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: Immune to thunder? Can it be because of... his rubber body?

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Stop it, you are annoying! (Beat down Enel with one hit)

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: Thunder has no effect on Luffy!

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: The one man who can fight against thunder. Enel probably never thought that such a man existed!

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: Maybe Luffy is Enel's one and only natural enemy!

army_word_cfg.name: Foxy
army_word_cfg.content: Hey, that horse is mine. I shot it. Don't touch it!

army_word_cfg.name: Porche
army_word_cfg.content: Yeah! That's my boss's horse!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: (Angry) Who the hell… are you?

army_word_cfg.name: Foxy
army_word_cfg.content: Who am I? He actually doesn't recognize my face!!!

army_word_cfg.name: Usopp
army_word_cfg.content: Damn! Are they the shooters?

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: I don't care about your face! But I'll kick your ass and send you flying!

army_word_cfg.name: Foxy
army_word_cfg.content: I am Foxy and I always get what I want!!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: You bastard!! "Rubber"…

army_word_cfg.name: Foxy
army_word_cfg.content: Hold it! Straw-hat Luffy?

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Eh? How do you know my name?

army_word_cfg.name: Foxy
army_word_cfg.content: We Foxy Pirates will challenge you Straw Hat pirates…

army_word_cfg.name: Foxy
army_word_cfg.content: ...to an official Davy Back Fight!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: What are you gabbling about? Just bring it on! If you want a fight, I accept it!

army_word_cfg.name: Porche
army_word_cfg.content: Better not go far away from the island if you don't want to get lost in the sea. Good Luck!

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: What does that mean? Who will do that?

army_word_cfg.name: Usopp
army_word_cfg.content: No, it isn't that simple (They are attacked from the shore)

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: How dirty, being stopped by the audience!

army_word_cfg.name: Porche
army_word_cfg.content: Ahaha…See ya!

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: What do you want to do with my Nami? Damn! Bastard! I'll kick your head off!

army_word_cfg.name: Porche
army_word_cfg.content: Sinking their ship will be much easier.

army_word_cfg.name: Foxy
army_word_cfg.content: I have…a naughty idea. Fuehehehe… "White Smoke Attack".

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: This place is the maze of currents. If we find the right path, the current will take the ship forward.

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: Smoke is useless to us. See, that's the navigator!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: （Close to the finish line）Great! Nami and others are taking the lead!

army_word_cfg.name: Foxy
army_word_cfg.content: Slowmo Beam…

army_word_cfg.name: Porche
army_word_cfg.content: Thanks for your support. Our victory was guaranteed.

army_word_cfg.name: Foxy
army_word_cfg.content: Haha..Great! Now hand over one of your friends.

army_word_cfg.name: Foxy
army_word_cfg.content: The first crew I'd like to have is you - Doctor Tony Tony Chopper! (Chopper is taken away)

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Stop crying, Chopper!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Be like a man! Sit tight and quietly watch the game.

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: We still have two rounds. That's enough for us to get back our emergency ration.

army_word_cfg.name: Hamburg
army_word_cfg.content: Boss asks me to battle. I thought the opponent would be some tough guy.

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: Who the hell are you?

army_word_cfg.name: Hamburg
army_word_cfg.content: Hahahaha, Gorilla Throw, Hamburger Hammer, Size Attack S-M-L! I win!

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: In your dreams! I'm not done yet! It'll be a shame if I ask Zoro for help.

army_word_cfg.name: Hamburg
army_word_cfg.content: Heehee, ready ---(The groggy Monsters takes Sanji and Zoro Down)

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Hey… Chef, give me 10 seconds.

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: 10 seconds? Not a problem. (Stands up)

army_word_cfg.name: Foxy
army_word_cfg.content: Hey, you, I'd like to have a "Monster Burger"

army_word_cfg.name: Hamburg
army_word_cfg.content: Hahaha, I'll smash you and make you a hamburger. Heehee, chop you into pieces like chopping vegetables!

army_word_cfg.name: Hamburg
army_word_cfg.content: Heehee, and finally flatter you with a huge iron pan. A "Monster Burger" is made.

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: You can't make good food with such lousy skills! Anti-Manner Kick! (Win)

army_word_cfg.name: Foxy
army_word_cfg.content: Oh, not bad! We're enemies, yet you are still worth my respect. Come on!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Rubber gun!

army_word_cfg.name: Foxy
army_word_cfg.content: Slowmo Beam!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Ah, my hand is slowing down!

army_word_cfg.name: Foxy
army_word_cfg.content: What, are you all bark and no bite?

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Damn! His Slowmo Beam is harder to deal with than I thought.
(After an intense battle, Luffy and Foxy are on the deck. Luffy is taken down again and again but stands up every time)

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: I'd rather die than give you my friends!

army_word_cfg.name: Foxy
army_word_cfg.content: What are you talking about!! I'll finish you off right away!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: I---will win!

army_word_cfg.name: Foxy
army_word_cfg.content: What nonsense are you talking about? You can barely stand up.

army_word_cfg.name: Foxy
army_word_cfg.content: However, if you want to go on, I will take you down until you're unable to stand up. Megaton Nine-Tails Rush!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Rubber Gatling (Luffy uses a mirror shard in his hand to reflect the Slowmo Beam, which hits Foxy)

army_word_cfg.name: Foxy
army_word_cfg.content: Damn… Damn..you!

army_word_cfg.name: Kuzan
army_word_cfg.content: Great, shore. Please step back. Ice Age!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Devil fruit!! The sea is frozen!

army_word_cfg.name: Robin
army_word_cfg.content: He's the logia-type.. Hie Hie Fruit user. This is the ability of a supreme admiral from Marine headquarter!

army_word_cfg.name: Kuzan
army_word_cfg.content: I'm just here…to see you Nico Robin…

army_word_cfg.name: Kuzan
army_word_cfg.content: You…better die here and now!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Don't fight. I want a one-on-one fight with him. Let's settle this, just you and me!

army_word_cfg.name: Kuzan
army_word_cfg.content: Cool with me...but I have no ship to take my prisoners away, so I have to kill you.

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Rubber Bullet!!

army_word_cfg.name: Kuzan
army_word_cfg.content: Ice Age!! (Luffy is frozen)

army_word_cfg.name: Kuzan
army_word_cfg.content: I was cheated. I win, but I accepted your 1v1 battle..

army_word_cfg.name: Kuzan
army_word_cfg.content: so if I do anything to others.. I break the promise.

army_word_cfg.name: Kuzan
army_word_cfg.content: Isn’t it, captain? Or … you really think you can defeat me?

army_word_cfg.name: Kuzan
army_word_cfg.content: I have something to tell you. You will not be able to…cope with Nico Robin in the future.

army_word_cfg.name: Blueno
army_word_cfg.content: Seems like the report is not true. I really thought we only had lost 5 men.

army_word_cfg.name: Blueno
army_word_cfg.content: It's the first time in the history that some one is able to break into the world government. You won't stop, will you?

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Yes, unless I die! Robin is behind the door right? Back off, dumb ox!

army_word_cfg.name: Blueno
army_word_cfg.content: You --seem don't realize what you are doing now constitutes an international crime!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: What are you trying to say?

army_word_cfg.name: Blueno
army_word_cfg.content: You are numbered and too weak to fight against World Government.

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Back off!

army_word_cfg.name: Blueno
army_word_cfg.content: Fighting against us is useless.

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Maybe, but now it's different. I won't lose!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: I don't care about the world or the government---We are coming to get Robin back!

army_word_cfg.name: Blueno
army_word_cfg.content: Gear Two?! Evolved skill?!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: I'm so lucky to meet you here. Rubber---!

army_word_cfg.name: Blueno
army_word_cfg.content: You want to deliver something big? The bigger it is, the easier it is to avoid. Go ahead!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Rubber Jet Rifle!!

army_word_cfg.name: Blueno
army_word_cfg.content: So fast... impossible…

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: You're pretty strong. Then, let me show you something more interesting.
(Blueno falls down)

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Robin ~~~~~~~~~!!! I'm picking you up~~~~~~~~~~~!!!

army_word_cfg.name: Usopp
army_word_cfg.content: Sorry.. Sanji…

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: It's ok. Everyone has both weaknesses and strengths. I'll get the key.

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: Let me do what you are incapable of.

army_word_cfg.name: Jabra
army_word_cfg.content: Wahaha! Changed the opponent! But it won't make a difference!

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: Analyze! You can do it. Robin will be saved as long as you are here.

army_word_cfg.name: Jabra
army_word_cfg.content: Wahahaha, better crush you. It's useless!

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: Your iron mass skill is really troublesome!!

army_word_cfg.name: Jabra
army_word_cfg.content: Heehee!! Your kick is useless to me…

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: We'll see! (Sanji gives an angry kick that sends Jabra away)

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: It works, Jabra. Thanks for the key!! Bye!

army_word_cfg.name: Jabra
army_word_cfg.content: Wait, how foolish of you to think that you can steal the key and run away!

army_word_cfg.name: Jabra
army_word_cfg.content: Like a wolf, I'll chase you to exhaustion and then devour you!

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: I didn't think I would run away, but I will not be killed, nor will I spare you!

army_word_cfg.name: Jabra
army_word_cfg.content: Spare me? Hahaha, worry about yourself!

army_word_cfg.name: Jabra
army_word_cfg.content: Better think about how to get away rather than think of that ominous woman!

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: Haha! You won't laugh for long! Diable Jambe! The destructive power is as strong as the devil!

army_word_cfg.name: Jabra
army_word_cfg.content: Hot! My bones are blazing hot and feel like they're going to break! What kind of kick is that?

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: It's made by a God and a Devil. A bit spicy, huh?

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: Get serious, ok? Are you going to lose your life to the so-called chivalry?

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: I..I don't want to die… but I don't kick girls. I was brought up this way. So..

army_word_cfg.name: Sanji
army_word_cfg.content: So, I won't kick girls even it means it'll kill me…!!!

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: Idiot!!! I'll take care of that woman! You and your chivalry…

army_word_cfg.name: Kalifa
army_word_cfg.content: We meet again, huh?

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: Thunderbolt Tempo! ----?! What is it? The thunder was blocked.. And turned into bubbles!

army_word_cfg.name: Kalifa
army_word_cfg.content: If you can't figure it out… you won't win!

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: It turns into bubbles like soap… Could she have eaten the bubble-bubble fruit?

army_word_cfg.name: Kalifa
army_word_cfg.content: Even if…you figure it out, you are doomed to lose!!

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: Is it useful in a fight? Looks weak!!

army_word_cfg.name: Kalifa
army_word_cfg.content: Don't forget, I'm still a killer for the assassin group. My nickname is "Golden Bubble"!

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: I can't even hold my Climate Baton… my legs are mushy… I can't stand up…!!

army_word_cfg.name: Kalifa
army_word_cfg.content: If you want to stop that monster, go ahead, but my mission is to kill you. Bow to your fate!

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: Climate Baton "Cloudy Tempo"——Rain and Cloud Combo!

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: I've seen through your ability including your CP9 power, so --- Electric Bubble!

army_word_cfg.name: Kalifa
army_word_cfg.content: Even if you can control the weather, so what? Six Powers are beyond the human extremity!

army_word_cfg.name: Nami
army_word_cfg.content: No matter how strong you are, my weather forecast won't fail me. My friends are waiting for me. If I were you, I would take it.

army_word_cfg.name: Kaku
army_word_cfg.content: Anyway, I said I like meat!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: I don't give a shit on what you like. Give me the key. If I can't catch up, I lose.

army_word_cfg.name: Kaku
army_word_cfg.content: Are you stronger with that headscarf on?

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Who knows？

army_word_cfg.name: Kaku
army_word_cfg.content: （Turns into a square）Iron mass without dead ends!  Square without dead ends!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Shut up! What are you doing, bastard? Are you gonna fight or not?

army_word_cfg.name: Kaku
army_word_cfg.content: Where are you staring at? Have a taste of my attack!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Er? Slashes! Damn! Santoryu!

army_word_cfg.name: Kaku
army_word_cfg.content: What power!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: If you're always look at things above, you won't notice what it's like being  beaten down… You hold your head too high!

army_word_cfg.name: Kaku
army_word_cfg.content: There's more you don't see. Giraffe's Wild Power!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Show me!

army_word_cfg.name: Kaku
army_word_cfg.content: Thanks for the reminder. Giraffe Fort---

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: What kind of creature are you?

army_word_cfg.name: Kaku
army_word_cfg.content: Tempest Kick Sky Slicer! Give up! You have nowhere to flee!

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: It's you who should give up! Demon Aura Nine Sword Style --- Asura! (Kaku is defeated)

army_word_cfg.name: Zoro
army_word_cfg.content: Ah, right! The boss of Galley-La Company asked me to give you a message - "You're fired!"

army_word_cfg.name: Rob Lucci
army_word_cfg.content: Did you forget, Straw-hat Luffy? I gave you a blow with this stance back in the Galley-La Company...

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Oh, that! I recovered after eating some meat. Jet Bazooka --- Frankie, go save Robin!

army_word_cfg.name: Rob Lucci
army_word_cfg.content: …I should have been more careful. Never expected you have such great power.

army_word_cfg.name: Rob Lucci
army_word_cfg.content: But you look like you're out of breath. Is that because of the steam?

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: I don't care what it takes, as long as I can defeat you!

army_word_cfg.name: Rob Lucci
army_word_cfg.content: What happened… how scary.

army_word_cfg.name: Rob Lucci
army_word_cfg.content: So it is… Indeed, your physical ability has been boosted.

army_word_cfg.name: Rob Lucci
army_word_cfg.content: But your body can't bear it. You are risking your life!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Compared with losing something important, I'd rather bear it myself!!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: If there's something that I can do, I will do it!

army_word_cfg.name: Rob Lucci
army_word_cfg.content: Get all of them out? What a pathetic wish! Show me!

army_word_cfg.name: Rob Lucci
army_word_cfg.content: (Smash the wall) Soon the room will filled with water. You must be worried about them. Go save them!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: I won't let you go!!! They will live through no matter how difficult it may be!

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: If I let you go, you'll go and kill them!

army_word_cfg.name: Rob Lucci
army_word_cfg.content: That's honorable, but it won't change anything if you die. Can you defeat me?

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Want a head-on battle? OK, let me show you another skill ---

army_word_cfg.name: Luffy
army_word_cfg.content: Gear Three---Bone Balloon! Check out my left hand! (Sends Rob Lucci flying)
